reservoirs.name: Lake Victoria / Jinja
reservoirs.note: Huge lake: each pass observes only part of it; use wse, not area, for monitoring.

reservoirs.name: GERD
reservoirs.note: Unnamed in PLD (prior extent is pre-filling, 220 km2). Observed WSE 600-607 m and up to 864 km2 extent reaching the dam. Parts of the filled reservoir may fall in LakeSP_unassigned; area_total underestimates true area.

reservoirs.name: Tekeze
reservoirs.note: Unnamed in PLD. Observed WSE 1135-1144 m (FSL ~1140 m), extent 76-150 km2 upstream of the dam.

reservoirs.name: Sennar Dam
reservoirs.note: Matched by GRanD id 4482. Observed WSE ~423 m. PLD polygon covers only the reach near the dam.

reservoirs.name: Jebel Aulia Dam
reservoirs.note: Small PLD fragments 1720053653 / 1720053663 also carry GRanD 4480; ignore them.

reservoirs.name: Upper Atbara and Setit Dam Complex
reservoirs.note: Unnamed in PLD. Observed WSE 511-521 m (FSL ~521 m), extent up to 175 km2 upstream of the dams.

reservoirs.name: Merowe Dam
reservoirs.note: PLD name is just 'NILE'. Observed WSE 286-299 m (FSL 300 m), extent up to 569 km2.

reservoirs.name: High Aswan Dam (Lake Nasser)
reservoirs.note: Not 1720055183 (GRanD 4477, 8 km2 - a separate small water body near the dam).
